runners_data.name: Tap Tap Shamie
runners_data.note: Sole pace-setter returns from 35-day break with solid recent form and Sean Bowen booking suggesting connections are confident despite the layoff.

runners_data.name: Rachel Lopez
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer carries concerning recent form but has shown ability on similar going, though her finishing kick has been questionable lately.

runners_data.name: Mickthesoldier
runners_data.note: Confirmed closer who ran creditably here seven days ago and benefits from quick return, but needs strong pace to be effective from his hold-up style.

runners_data.name: Colinski
runners_data.note: Four-year-old hold-up horse returns from 11-day break with solid course record and useful second-season chasing experience under Rebecca Menzies.

runners_data.name: Palavar
runners_data.note: Backmarker whose modest form figures and complete lack of wins or places on Good going make him hard to fancy despite the low weight.

runners_data.name: Hashtag Queen
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who showed promise with third place two starts back but has been inconsistent and relies on 5lb claimer Joshua Thompson.

races.paceDynamic: Tap Tap Shamie will lead from the gate as the sole confirmed front runner in this small field, setting what should be a measured tempo without pressure. Hashtag Queen may sit prominent early but lacks the pace to challenge the leader, while the bulk of the field - Mickthesoldier, Colinski, and Palavar - all prefer to come from off the pace. With no genuine pace pressure on Tap Tap Shamie through the early stages, this race strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can dictate terms, making life difficult for the hold-up brigade who need a strong gallop to be effective.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Wire-to-wire dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Tap Tap Shamie handles the 2m trip and Good going effectively from the front
scenarios.body: The leader controls every call without serious pressure, kicking clear after the last hurdle as the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in time. This sustained gallop suits the one horse with proven front-running ability over similar distances.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late sustained challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get the strong gallop they need when Tap Tap Shamie quickens
scenarios.body: Colinski or Mickthesoldier produce their trademark late surge as the pace lifts sufficiently in the final half-mile. The 4-year-old Colinski particularly appeals with his solid placing record and lighter weight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Hashtag Queen or Rachel Lopez can sit close enough to pounce when Tap Tap Shamie tires
scenarios.body: The pace-setter begins to weaken after the final hurdle, allowing a horse that tracked the early pace to strike with a well-timed challenge. Rachel Lopez's lack of recent form makes this scenario rely heavily on Hashtag Queen finding improvement.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Tap Tap Shamie goes too fast early or makes jumping errors under pressure
scenarios.body: The front runner compromises his chance through tactical errors, leaving the race wide open for any horse capable of staying the trip. This unlikely scenario would need multiple things to go wrong for the pace-setter.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Tap Tap Shamie getting too keen early as Sean Bowen attempts to control the pace from the front without company.
Monitor Rachel Lopez's jumping rhythm as she showed signs of losing concentration when out of contention in recent runs.
Observe how quickly Colinski travels into the race given his 11-day turnaround and whether the Good going suits his action.
Check if any of the hold-up horses can get into striking position before the final hurdle as they'll need to be closer than usual.
Watch Hashtag Queen's position turning for home as she needs to be within striking distance to utilize any finishing kick.

races.paceDynamic: V Twelve stands alone as the confirmed pace-setter, returning from a long break with front-running credentials that should see him dictate terms unchallenged early. Zero Tolerance and Beat The Edge offer prominent support but neither shows natural pace to pressure V Twelve's lead. The overwhelming hold-up contingent including Ghasham, We Got Your Back, and Conquer The Breeze will track behind, creating a sitting duck scenario for the leader. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can capitalize on a lone front-runner setting potentially unsustainable fractions over this stamina-sapping trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If V Twelve sets predictable fractions from the front unchallenged
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade gets the perfect setup to pounce late, with the leader vulnerable to a sustained challenge up the hill. Quality closers like Ghasham and We Got Your Back are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If Zero Tolerance or Beat The Edge press forward to apply early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace quickens enough to compromise both leader and hold-up horses, allowing the prominently-raced pair to strike from an ideal stalking position. Their tactical positioning proves optimal when others have too much work to do late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If V Twelve's long absence proves beneficial and he stays strongly
scenarios.body: The Martin Todhunter-trained gelding uses his uncontested lead to full advantage, kicking clear before the hold-up horses can organize their challenge. His natural stamina reserves prove deeper than expected despite the layoff.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling with multiple horses tracking
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish where tactical positioning matters less than raw speed and luck in running. Any horse with a clear passage and turn of foot can capitalize on the scramble.

races.paceDynamic: Betterforeveryone will likely dictate terms from the front without serious pressure, as most rivals prefer to race prominently rather than challenge for the early lead. Hostile Hotelier, Jet Legs, No Regrets and Court At Slip will track in the second rank, while Gold Clermont, You Some Girl and Eaton Anne are natural hold-up performers who need the race to develop. With one uncontested leader setting sustainable fractions over this staying trip, the pace scenario clearly favours the prominent trackers who can position close enough to strike but avoid the stamina-sapping donkey work.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Betterforeveryone gets an easy lead and maintains rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: The front-runner controls the tempo completely and has enough left for the finish, while prominent horses get first run but cannot match the leader's positional advantage. This 3-mile test becomes a pure stamina examination where tactical position trumps late speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Success
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses time their challenges perfectly as Betterforeveryone begins to tire
scenarios.body: The pace becomes honest enough to set up those tracking in second, with Hostile Hotelier or Jet Legs able to strike at the optimum moment. The leader's long stint in front tells in the final half-mile, allowing the smart tactical rides to prevail.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and the prominent group goes too fast chasing Betterforeveryone
scenarios.body: The race falls apart in the final mile, creating the perfect scenario for the back-markers to pick up the pieces. Gold Clermont or You Some Girl benefit from their patient positioning as the early leaders pay for their exertions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Betterforeveryone goes very slowly and creates a sprint finish from the final fence
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns this into an extended sprint where class and finishing speed matter most. This completely changes the complexion, favouring horses with the highest ratings who can quicken from any position.

races.paceDynamic: Peaceinthevalley will take the field along as the only confirmed front runner, setting a sustainable pace without pressure from fellow pace-setters. Eagles Rock and several other prominent runners (Whatudoing, Second Subaltern, Economic Editor, Pulse Of Camelot) will track within striking distance, creating a decent gallop but nothing extreme. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Eastern Storm, Bentley Road, Sunset On Fire, Imperial Imp) will settle at the rear and rely on staying power up Hexham's challenging climb. This tactical setup clearly favours the prominent runners who can position handy and strike before the hill saps momentum from closers.

scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays honest and the prominent horses get first run on the leaders
scenarios.body: Eagles Rock and Second Subaltern can use their handy positions to strike turning for home before the hold-up horses get organized. The sustained gallop and Hexham's demands will blunt the finishing kicks of the back markers.

scenarios.body: Eastern Storm and Sunset On Fire can use their proven stamina to grind past tiring leaders up the punishing Hexham hill. Their hold-up style becomes an asset when others have expended energy too soon.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Peaceinthevalley gets an easy lead and finds extra gear when challenged
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows him to dictate terms and kick clear when the challengers arrive. His prominent style becomes front-running tactics when unopposed early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a sprint or several favorites disappoint
scenarios.body: Economic Editor or Pulse Of Camelot can benefit from a messy race where class levels drop. Their lower ratings become less relevant in a tactical affair where positioning matters more than ability.

scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate allowing prominent runners to stay closer
